description:
Solitaire, the classic solo card game, comes to your phone with Solitaire Classic Era! 🃏

Play free solitaire with new game modes, options and customized cards. ♥️ Card games are a great way to enjoy your free time, and Solitaire Classic Era gives you fun, customizable way to enjoy it! ♣️ Don't miss this soiltare game!

Play solitary for fun, or track your scores and compete to reach the top of the scoreboard!

Play Klondike patience whenever you feel the need ♦️ you don’t need a deck of cards, you just need your phone and Solitaire Classic Era. ♠️ Download now!
